problems.reason: Sentence 4 claims Delphinornis lived until the middle Miocene, but sentence 5 limits its fossils to 15.98 Ma, which is the boundary of the early Miocene, not the middle Miocene.

notes: - contradiction: "Delphinornis was an extinct genus of penguins that lived in Antarctica from the middle Eocene to the middle Miocene." / "Fossils of Delphinornis date from 41.03 to 15.98 million years ago, spanning the Bartonian to Burdigalian stages.": Sentence 4 claims Delphinornis lived until the middle Miocene, but sentence 5 limits its fossils to 15.98 Ma, which is the boundary of the early Miocene, not the middle Miocene.
